content.body: This shoulder-fired anti-tank rocket launcher was created in reaction to the US M1A1 Bazooka. It was nicknamed the "Ofenrohr" ("Stovepipe") for its appearance, but "Panzerschreck" ("Tank Horror") for what it did to targets. Using a heavy 88mm rocket with a shaped HEAT charge, it could penetrate more than 8 inches of armor in optimal conditions.
content.brief: WEAPON: Raketenpanzerbüchse 54 AMMO: RPzB.Gr 4322 88 mm HEAT Rocket (4) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 110 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-shot OTHER EQUIPMENT: Luger Pistole 08 9 mm Automatic Combat Knife
